blocker.summary: C5 fails because the PAR-02 test uses a hardcoded UUID literal in the events query instead of a shared constant or per-test generated value.

context.issue_fixer_status: blocked by GitHub service disruption; GitHub issue creation attempt failed with key-missing error

task.description:
Fix the PAR-02 test isolation blocker by removing the hardcoded UUID literal from tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig and using a shared exported platform sentinel from event_store instead. The minimal likely fix is to export PLATFORM_INSTANCE_ID (and related sentinels if useful) from src/event_store/store.zig, then replace the literal in the PAR-02 test with bpm.store.PLATFORM_INSTANCE_ID or an equivalent exported constant.

Preserve current test semantics: the query must still target the same platform event instance_id used by appendPlatform(), but must no longer contain a literal UUID in the test file.

After the code change, run zig build, zig build test, zig build test-env-verify, and zig build test-integration-par02. Update the handoff with the result and any remaining issues.
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig no longer contains a hardcoded UUID literal at line 177

result.summary: Removed the hardcoded platform-instance UUID from the PAR-02 integration test by reusing the exported shared sentinel from the event store; the literal is no longer present, but the PAR-02 integration target still fails in this environment because the maintenance cycle reports zero partitions_created.

issues.description: The test isolation defect was fixed by replacing the literal UUID with bpm.store.PLATFORM_INSTANCE_ID, but the PAR-02 integration suite remains red because runMaintenanceCycle produces zero partitions_created in the current database state.

result.next_action: Route to ISSUE-FIXER for the remaining PAR-02 scheduler root cause (Step 0.5/1)
